text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT PD-89012 fired - Service: inference-hosting-uswest - Symptom: p99 latency > 1400ms (5m window). Pager: @oncall-alex. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-89012

oncall-alex: ack — I'm on it, triaging now.

incident-bot: auto-remediation: none. Related metrics: p95=320ms p99=1420ms error_rate=0.6% kvcache_evictions=high.

sre-maya: seeing the same in dashboards — spike concentrated on /generate-token routes, tails only. QPS flat, not a traffic surge. Starting KV cache and sidecar checks.

eng-lucas: logs from gpu-sidecar: "kvcache miss_ratio=0.82, batch_size=1->8, enqueue_delay=12ms". Redis cmdstats INCRBY and EVICTs spiked at 01:10Z. Possible hotkey or bad prompt distribution.

oncall-alex: mitigation plan: 1) shift portion of traffic to fallback quantized variant; 2) scale up us-west dedicated pool +2 GPUs; 3) increase batch timeout to encourage larger batches. Applying step 1 now.

oncall-alex: ```/run rollout --route generate --variant rdm-small-quant --percent 30 --note "miniwave immediate mitigation"```

incident-bot: rollout job started (task_id=abc123).

support-jordan: customer impact: CS reported two customers saw request timeouts ~01:08-01:12Z, escalating to eng. I'm drafting a brief advisory.

sre-maya: sending scale request to autoscaler: request_id=scale-xyz -> +2 gpus to us-west pool.

eng-lucas: pushing a config tweak to increase batch timeout from 50ms -> 80ms for generate route to smooth tails (temp change). Will monitor for throughput regressions.

oncall-alex: partial traffic shift at 30% -> p99 dropped from 1420ms -> ~600ms within 2m. Good sign. Continuing monitoring. If p99 > 500ms after 10m escalate to SRE lead.

incident-bot: PD-89012 acknowledged by oncall-alex.

oncall-alex: brief handoff to @sre-maya for sustained watch/overnight: summary: "miniwave" tail spike caused by KV-cache thrash + localized hotkey behavior. Actions taken: partial traffic shift to rdm-small-quant (30%), +2 GPUs to dedicated pool, batch timeout increased to 80ms. Customer impact: transient timeouts for small subset; CS alerted. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-kvcache.

sre-maya: ack — I'll keep eyes on p99 and eviction rate. Will follow up with root-cause analysis and a post-incident ticket. Please attach any relevant logs/trace ids to PD-89012.

support-jordan: posting customer advisory now: "We observed a transient latency spike affecting a subset of requests in US-West. Mitigations have been applied and performance is improving. If you see errors, please share request-id in reply." :speech_balloon: 

oncall-alex: closing immediate loop for the on-call shift. Will create incident ticket PD-89012 and add to postmortem board. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

sre-maya: adding a note to the incident: investigate hotkey distribution and KV cache sizing + consider guardrail to prevent eviction storms.

eng-lucas: collected sample request_ids: [req_8f3a, req_8f3b, req_8f4c] and a sidecar dump (link: https://artifacts.internal/incident/PD-89012/sidecar-dump.tgz).

oncall-alex: handing off fully — @sre-maya you own until it's stable. If p99 regresses above 700ms, re-open PD and escalate.

sre-maya: will do.
